headline: Cooking Up Growth with Better Margins

highlights: Key Points  Revenue came in above our estimates at Rs5.8bn (+23.2% YoY), driven by strong demand across induction cooktops, pressure cookers and small appliances, supported by robust growth in general trade, expansion of Pigeon’s retail network, Gilma’s relaunch and continued omnichannel expansion.

Manufacturing agility, improved product availability and new product launches further supported growth.  Stovekraft continues to strengthen its retail presence through the expansion of Pigeon stores, with 360 stores currently operational and plans to add 75–100 stores annually.
Additionally, the relaunch of premium brand Gilma, which currently operates 17 stores, provides another growth avenue, with the management targeting 100 stores over the next 24 months.

Overall, Stovekraft aims to expand its combined Pigeon and Gilma retail network to 500 stores by FY28.  The management remains confident of sustaining 20–25% revenue growth, targeting Rs25–30bn revenue over the next 2–3 years, supported by existing capacities.
